data.spiritual_meaning: Janus expresses “God of beginnings, gates, and transitions”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Janus total 11, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
